```artifact
**Test Case ID** | **Title** | **Requirement ID(s)** | **Kind** | **Preconditions** | **Input(s)** | **Steps** | **Expected**
---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---
TC-001 | Verify Back-up Schedule | Req-13 | Positive | System is running | None | System performs full back-up of both Database and Code at 00:00 every night | Back-up files are sent to remote site |
TC-002 | Verify Back-up Rotation | Req-13 | Positive | Back-up files exist | None | System rotates back-up files every 30 days | Old back-up files are deleted |
TC-003 | Verify Password Change | VIRTUA-13-1 | Positive | User is logged in | New password | User changes password successfully | User can log in with new password |
TC-004 | Verify Patient Registration | VIRTUA-13-2 | Positive | None | User-id, password | Patient registers successfully | Patient account is created with specified User-id and password |
TC-005 | Verify Doctor Appointment Report | VIRTUA-13-3.1 | Positive | User is logged in | Date range | System generates report with appointments for next 5 days | Report contains correct doctor information and appointment details |
TC-006 | Verify Consultation Report | VIRTUA-13-3.2 | Positive | User is logged in | Date range | System generates report with consultation data per month/quarter/year | Report contains correct doctor information, consultation count, and date range |
TC-007 | Verify Revenue Report | VIRTUA-13-3.3 | Positive | User is logged in | Date range | System generates report with revenue data per month/quarter/year | Report contains correct doctor information, revenue amount, and date range |
TC-008 | Verify Invalid Password | VIRTUA-13-1 | Negative | User is not logged in | Incorrect password | User receives error message | User cannot log in with incorrect password |
TC-009 | Verify Missing User-id | VIRTUA-13-2 | Negative | None | Missing User-id | System displays error message | Patient registration fails without User-id |
```
